_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every printed QR code. build.mjs emits one landing page per slug, scripts/gen_qr.py regenerates the PNGs embedded in the printed menus, and the CI verify job tests every entry after each deploy. Because all three read this file, a QR image can never point at a route that does not exist. To add or repoint a code, edit ONLY this file, then run: python3 scripts/gen_qr.py
